observations: The page number «24» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L20: the vertical bar between «coacervatum32)» and «cum» marks the beginning of fol. 42 recto of N, which the note in the left margin, «N 42r», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L01-L26: the true places of the sun and the moon at the mean syzygy; the interval between them, increased by half a sixth of itself, a twelfth, is added to the place of the moon and the twelfth to the place of the sun when the sun is ahead, and subtracted when the moon is; the same to the argument of latitude; the interval with its twelfth, divided by the moon's hourly motion, gives the hours to be added or subtracted. Checked: the moon gains on the sun about 12;11 degrees a day, so that while it closes an interval the sun moves on about one twelfth of it, which the twelfth added to the interval allows for. L26: the hours times 0;32,40 correct the moon's anomaly. Checked: the daily motion in anomaly, about 13° 3′ 54″, divided by twenty-four gives 32′ 40″; the reading of C, 32′ 50″ (note 40), does not.

L17: «(scilicet additis VI signis)», the round brackets of the text, which note 27 calls «unci»: N has the words in the margin. L02, L04, L05 and L19: «elaug», «tadil», «elwacat», «elbuht» in italics.

N09: note 18 has no lemma; it gives what C writes above «praecesserit». N06: a speck above the o of «om.»; not transcribed. N01, N03, N07, N18, N20: «C O», «C O N», «O N», the sigla with a space between them.
The semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (9-13 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: the readings within a note are divided by commas, «aut] C, om. O.» (N12); after the siglum C a full stop is printed before «om.»
